summary: A prompt library app that stores and organizes prompts by categories. Features a search bar, favorites section, and category management to help users quickly find and copy their saved prompts.
architectural_notes: Categories displayed in responsive grid layout with automatic wrapping to ensure all items are visible on screen
Layout order: search bar at top, then Favorites and Create Category buttons, followed by category buttons

existing_features.title: Modify the category filter bar to display all categories in a responsive grid layout that wraps to multiple rows, ensuring all 22-23 categories are visible on screen simultaneously without horizontal overflow
Ensure the category grid appears directly below the search bar, with Favorites and Create Category buttons positioned at the start of the category list, followed by all user-created categories

new_feature_requests.summary: Display all categories in a responsive grid layout below search bar that wraps to multiple rows
Search bar at the top of the app
Create Category button below search bar
Ability to store and organize prompts by categories
Ability to copy prompts after finding them
